matchstick.title: Balance by numeric difference and single‑stick transformation
matchstick.principle: First compute the integer values of both sides, find the numeric difference, then search for a single‑stick transformation that can adjust the values accordingly.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is numerically imbalanced and a single‑stick move could potentially balance it.
matchstick.example: Attempting to move a stick without first checking the numeric difference, leading to an unchanged imbalance.

matchstick.title: Convert V to X to add 5
matchstick.principle: If the numeric imbalance is exactly 5 and a V appears, relocate one of V’s diagonal sticks to cross, turning V into X and increasing its value by 5.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 5 and a V is present, consider converting V to X.
matchstick.example: Moving a diagonal from V to form X but leaving the original V with only one diagonal, which is not a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Change + to - and add I
matchstick.principle: If changing a plus sign to a minus sign reduces the right‑hand side by the needed amount, also add an extra I (vertical stick) to a numeral to compensate for the removed vertical stick.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation can be balanced by turning '+' into '-' and increasing a numeral by 1.
matchstick.example: Changing '+' to '-' without adding the required vertical stick, resulting in an incomplete plus sign.

matchstick.title: Transfer I stick between numerals
matchstick.principle: When the numeric imbalance is even (or any integer) and there are numerals containing multiple I’s, move a vertical stick from one numeral to another to adjust their values appropriately.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by a value that can be corrected by moving a single I between numerals.
matchstick.example: Moving a vertical stick from an I that would leave the source numeral empty, making it invalid.

matchstick.title: Change - to = by adding a horizontal stick from a numeral
matchstick.principle: If a minus sign appears and the numeric imbalance is large, move a horizontal stick from a numeral (e.g., from an I or V) to the minus sign, turning it into an equality sign while adjusting the numeral’s value.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation can be balanced by converting '-' into '=' and the source numeral can lose a horizontal stick without becoming invalid.
matchstick.example: Removing a horizontal stick from a numeral that cannot lose one (e.g., X) and leaving it invalid.

matchstick.title: Relocate minus sign to a different position
matchstick.principle: When a minus sign appears, consider moving its single horizontal stick to a new location, creating a valid minus sign elsewhere and potentially forming a new operator or numeral.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation can be balanced by repositioning the minus sign.
matchstick.example: Moving the minus sign’s stick to a place where it no longer forms a valid operator.

matchstick.title: When converting - to +, also move a vertical stick to form a valid plus sign
matchstick.principle: If you need to change a minus sign into a plus sign, you must also relocate a vertical stick to accompany the existing horizontal stick, ensuring the resulting '+' is complete.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation requires turning '-' into '+' to adjust the value.
matchstick.example: Changing '-' to '+' without adding the required vertical stick, resulting in an incomplete plus sign.

matchstick.title: Swap '-' and '=' by moving a horizontal stick
matchstick.principle: If swapping the positions of the minus and equality signs by moving a single horizontal stick can balance the equation, perform the swap, ensuring both signs remain valid.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by a value that matches the effect of swapping '-' and '=', and both signs are present.
matchstick.example: Moving a horizontal stick from '=' to '-' but leaving the original '=' with only one horizontal stick, turning it into a minus sign.

matchstick.title: Ensure a valid '=' remains when moving a stick from '='
matchstick.principle: If you relocate a stick from the equality sign, simultaneously create a new equality sign elsewhere to keep exactly one valid '=' in the equation.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a solution involves moving a stick from '=', make sure another '=' is formed to preserve the equality operator.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from '=' and leaving no valid '=' sign in the equation.

matchstick.title: Convert X to V to subtract 5
matchstick.principle: If the numeric imbalance is exactly 5 and an X appears, relocate one of X’s diagonal sticks away (to any location that does not affect other characters) to turn X into V, reducing its value by 5.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 5 and an X is present, consider converting X to V by moving a diagonal stick.
matchstick.example: Removing a diagonal from X without ensuring the source remains a valid numeral, leaving a single diagonal character that is not a recognized Roman numeral.

matchstick.description: Moving a stick from a numeral that cannot lose a stick without becoming invalid (e.g., X, V)
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model assumes any stick can be removed, ignoring that some numerals need all their sticks to stay valid.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Before moving a stick, verify that the source numeral remains a valid Roman numeral after the removal.

matchstick.description: Providing an incomplete equation after moving a stick
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may forget to replace the moved stick, leaving a missing character.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Ensure the moved stick is placed somewhere else, preserving the total number of characters.

matchstick.description: Changing – to + without adding the required vertical stick (resulting in an incomplete plus sign)
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model treats operators as interchangeable without respecting their stick composition.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: When converting – to +, also add a vertical stick to complete the plus sign.

matchstick.description: Using an angled stick as a vertical stick (or vice versa), creating an invalid numeral or operator
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Maintain stick orientation: diagonal sticks stay diagonal, vertical sticks stay vertical.

matchstick.description: Moving a stick from the equality sign and leaving no valid '=' sign in the equation
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may remove a horizontal from '=', forgetting to create a new equality sign.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: If a stick is taken from '=', ensure another '=' is formed elsewhere.
